"""Connection to the ops MCP server, launched as a subprocess over stdio."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shlex
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from mcp import ClientSession, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

DEFAULT_SERVER = "ops-mcp"


def server_command() -> list[str]:
    """The server command line from $OPSBOT_SERVER (default: `ops-mcp`)."""
    return shlex.split(os.environ.get("OPSBOT_SERVER", DEFAULT_SERVER))


@asynccontextmanager
async def open_session(command: list[str] | None = None) -> AsyncIterator[ClientSession]:
    """Start the server and yield an initialized client session."""
    program, *args = command or server_command()
    params = StdioServerParameters(command=program, args=args)
    async with stdio_client(params) as (read, write):
        async with ClientSession(read, write) as session:
            await session.initialize()
            yield session


async def tool_names(session: ClientSession) -> list[str]:
    """Names of the tools the server offers, sorted."""
    listing = await session.list_tools()
    return sorted(tool.name for tool in listing.tools)

import anyio
import mcp.types as types
import pytest

from opsbot.calls import ToolCallFailed, run_tool


class StubSession:
    def __init__(self, result: types.CallToolResult) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.calls = []

    async def call_tool(self, name, arguments=None):
        self.calls.append((name, arguments))
        return self.result


def text(*lines):
    return [types.TextContent(type="text", text=line) for line in lines]


def run(result):
    session = StubSession(result)
    value = anyio.run(run_tool, session, "deploy", {"service": "api"})
    assert session.calls == [("deploy", {"service": "api"})]
    return value


def test_error_raises_with_joined_text():
    with pytest.raises(ToolCallFailed) as info:
        run(types.CallToolResult(content=text("no such", "version"), is_error=True))
    assert (info.value.tool, info.value.message) == ("deploy", "no such\nversion")


def test_structured_output_returned_as_is():
    assert run(types.CallToolResult(content=text("ignored"), structured_content={"ok": True})) == {"ok": True}
    assert run(types.CallToolResult(content=text("ignored"), structured_content=[])) == []


def test_text_joined_when_no_structured_output():
    image = types.ImageContent(type="image", data="", mime_type="image/png")
    assert run(types.CallToolResult(content=[*text("a"), image, *text("b")])) == "a\nb"
